cards.title: Your Inbox
cards.description: Monday morning. One unread email marked URGENT. Anonymous sender.
cards.image_prompt: A corporate email inbox on a monitor, single unread email highlighted in red marked URGENT, dark office, Monday morning light through blinds, tense atmosphere.

cards.title: Urgent Escalation
cards.description:
Subject: Urgent — Review Required: CR-2026-0312

A connected transaction executed last week may not have followed the prescribed disclosure process. Please conduct an immediate review and confirm whether a Chapter 14A notification is required. Exchange filing window is active.

cards.title: Case Opened
cards.description: Case CR-2026-0312 confirmed. Transaction records unlocked for review.

cards.title: Legal Hold
cards.description:
Legal puts a 48-hour hold on all communications. Time wasted.

⏱️ −30 seconds

cards.title: Deleted Evidence
cards.description:
You deleted the email. Records Management restored it within 30 seconds — the item is subject to a regulatory retention obligation. 'Deletion of flagged correspondence is not permitted under the firm's document retention policy.'

⏱️ −30 seconds

cards.title: Not Phishing
cards.description:
Information Security reviewed the flagged item and confirmed: 'This is not a phishing attempt. The correspondence has been verified as legitimate. Please action accordingly.'

⏱️ −30 seconds

cards.title: Management Unavailable
cards.description:
Senior management is unreachable. The PA replies: 'They'll circle back next quarter.'

⏱️ −30 seconds

cards.title: Transaction Records
cards.description: Four transactions flagged under the connected party register. Determine which one requires mandatory disclosure.
cards.image_prompt: A corporate computer screen displaying four transaction file folders, spreadsheet data visible, dark office with blue monitor glow, financial documents scattered.

cards.title: Transaction A
cards.description: NT-2026-0847. Connected party: Director Zhang. Amount: HK$52M. Market cap: HK$900M.

cards.title: Transaction B
cards.description: NT-2026-0912. Connected party: Director Lee. Amount: HK$48M. Market cap: HK$1.1B.

cards.title: Transaction C
cards.description: NT-2026-0853. Connected party: Director Wong. Amount: HK$15M. Market cap: HK$400M.

cards.title: Transaction D
cards.description: NT-2026-0891. Connected party: Director Chan. Amount: HK$30M. Market cap: HK$750M.

cards.title: Breach Identified
cards.description: Transaction A confirmed: 5.78% exceeds the 5% connected transaction threshold.

cards.title: False Alarm
cards.description:
Transaction B is 4.36% — within threshold. The Exchange responds: 'Not a breach.' Credibility lost.

⚠️ Penalty

cards.title: Wrong Transaction
cards.description:
Transaction C is 3.75% — well within threshold. You flagged the wrong one. Back to the calculator.

⏱️ −30 seconds

cards.title: Reference Mismatch
cards.description:
Transaction D's reference is NT-0891, not NT-0847. Close reading matters.

⏱️ −30 seconds

cards.title: Interview Room
cards.description: Three department heads were involved in the transaction approval chain. Determine each person's level of knowledge regarding the undisclosed connected transaction.
cards.image_prompt: A corporate interview room with three chairs occupied by silhouetted figures, glass table, dim overhead lighting, interrogation atmosphere, corporate thriller mood.

cards.title: Finance Head Statement
cards.description: "I approved NT-0847 on Tuesday. Standard process. Nothing unusual."

cards.title: Operations Head Statement
cards.description: "Nothing crossed my desk regarding NT-0847. First I'm hearing of it."

cards.title: Compliance Head Statement
cards.description: "Finance told me Thursday that NT-0847 was approved Tuesday. I asked why I wasn't notified."

cards.title: Concealment Identified
cards.description: Finance Head approved it Tuesday but told Compliance on Thursday — a 2-day delay. Deliberate concealment.

cards.title: Wrong Timeline
cards.description:
You cited Finance's timeline. The Exchange cross-checks — the notification gap proves concealment, not compliance.

⚠️ Penalty

cards.title: Classification Terminal
cards.description: Final step. Classify the breach and file. No hints. Get it right.
cards.image_prompt: A secure terminal screen showing a breach classification form with dropdown fields, dark room, red warning indicators, corporate high-security atmosphere.

cards.title: Filing Requirements
cards.description: Select: Chapter violated, Severity, Classification, Deadline. All must be correct.

cards.title: Filing Complete
cards.description: All fields validated. Breach notification has been prepared and is ready for submission to the Exchange.

cards.title: Wrong Classification
cards.description:
Negligence? The evidence shows deliberate concealment. SFC wants a word.

⚠️ Penalty

cards.title: Congratulations
cards.description: Filing confirmed. The breach notification has been accepted by the Exchange. Your team correctly identified the undisclosed transaction, established the approval chain, and submitted within the mandatory disclosure window.
